content: Rohan Ahuja contacted insurance agent Sunita Agarwal to inquire about options, steps, and costs for reinstating his expired health policy (HP-123456) with DCoders. Sunita replied with an attached reinstatement quote, explaining that payment of the outstanding premium and a small fee is required, and asked him to confirm if he wishes to proceed.

action_items: Confirm with the agent whether to proceed with the reinstatement
